coverage.priority: Whole Germany; rank by technical fit rather than geography
coverage.publicationThreshold: 75% minimum CV match; 90%+ is the strong-match view
coverage.sourceCoveragePrinciple: Germany-wide broad discovery across mandatory job portals, official employer career pages, public employment and research portals, universities, ATS feeds, MedTech ecosystem sources, specialist recruiters and reputable aggregators. Non-German roles are not published in the active Germany report.
additionalGermanySourceLayers: MedTech associations/clusters including BVMed, MedicalMountains, VDE and IEEE EMBS
specialist recruiters including FERCHAU, Bertrandt, Brunel and Hays Life Sciences
other reputable job boards and aggregators
coverage.searchMethod: Daily incremental discovery using past-24h/past-week searches plus known-employer ATS polling where legitimately available; periodic broad recall sweeps; official-source verification before publication; current/open verification; 0-years hard gate; genuine CV/technical match; language and work-authorization assessment; separate sponsorship/relocation signals; vacancy-fingerprint deduplication; material-change detection; false-negative hunt; publish only matches at or above 75%.
coverage.acceptanceAssessment: PASS for today's Germany-wide refresh. Two new Germany opportunities met the 75% threshold and were marked FRESH after historical comparison. Five previously reported qualifying roles remain active. Several technically interesting roles were excluded because they were below 75%, outside Germany, required materially different experience/skills, or could not be verified strongly enough for active publication.
limitations: A 75% score is a modelled CV-fit assessment, not a guarantee of hiring success
Search engines and portals expose different subsets and metadata
No single run can honestly claim 100% recall across every German vacancy
Work authorization remains country/role-specific unless explicitly verified
Job-board result counts are discovery indicators, not candidate-fit counts
Some employer/ATS pages expose limited searchable metadata
Historical freshness depends on exact-vacancy fingerprinting, not posting-date changes or duplicate board copies
